content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Cochin Port Authority Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Cochin Port Authority to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Cochin Port Authority Class-I Posts is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Class-I posts in Cochin Port Authority?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Class-I posts, including Marine Engineer and Dy. Director (Research), in the Cochin Port Authority recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Marine Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Marine Engineer post, candidates need to possess a MOT 1st Class Motor Certificate or Marine Engineer Officer Class I Certificate. Additionally, one year of post-qualification experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Dy. Director (Research) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Dy. Director (Research) post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Cochin Port Authority recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 400 for General/OBC/SC/ST/EWS categories. However, SC/ST candidates applying for reserved posts are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these Class-I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test/Shortlisting with 85% weightage, followed by a Personal Interview with 15% weightage.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Marine Engineer post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Marine Engineer post ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any work experience required for the Dy. Director (Research) post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for the Dy. Director (Research) post must have five years of executive experience in planning or data-related activities.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Cochin Port Authority?
faq.answer: The official website of Cochin Port Authority is www.cochinport.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and updates.
